text:
elaine: quick heads-up — dropping the mock for the new Quickstart surface. goal: help first-run users pick a sample project + optionally leave a 1-question 'why here' micro-survey. want accessibility + copy + layout nit checks before i push to figma. :eyes:

sam_p: looks slick. quick q — do we show 3 or 4 sample tiles? mobile feels cramped with 4.

elaine: thinking 3 across desktop, 1 per row on mobile. we can show a 'more samples' drawer if folks want extras.

maria_ud: love the drawer idea. can we surface estimated runtime & cost per sample? that'll help users pick realistic demos.

tyler_eng: technically fine to add small badges. prefer 'tiny' copy so tokens/cost don't dominate. also need to think about telemetry opt-in flow — shouldn't block first-run.

elaine: agreed. idea: show a brief inline toggle "Share usage to improve sample recommendations" with a link to privacy. non-blocking, default off.

aria_a11y: accessibility nits: color contrast for the sample title overlay is 3.5:1 currently (fails AA). need >=4.5:1 for body text. also keyboard focus order jumps from banner to footer — sample tiles should be first interactive elements after header.

elaine: good catch, aria. suggested overlay bg `#1b2340` at 80% worked in my quick test. does that meet contrast?

aria_a11y: try `#162033` at 88% or bump font weight. also add `aria-describedby` that ties tile to its short description and add `role="button"` for screen readers.

tyler_eng: can add `tabindex=0` and `aria-pressed` for selected samples in the implementation. will prototype.

lisa_research: from session playback, users expect clear action copy. avoid "Start" alone — use contextual CTAs like "Start chat app" or "Run summarization demo". increases completion in tests.

sam_p: +1. Also copy suggestion for the banner micro-survey: short and neutral. options: 1) "What brought you here today?" 2) "Pick a goal" 3) single freeform. lean toward 2 (preset goals) for easier analytics.

elaine: draft copy for the inline survey (2 options UI):

Variant A:
"What do you want to build?" [Chat app] [Search] [Assistant] [Custom]

Variant B:
"Pick your goal" — short dropdown with same options and a "Skip" link.

which is less noisy?

maria_ud: Variant A visually nudges choices. Variant B is lighter. maybe A for first-time only, B for returners.

tyler_eng: we should also log selection as a custom event `onboard.sample_goal` for later funnel analysis. ops-bot: any concerns about event volume?

ops-bot: ops-bot: FYI — analytics team recommends sampling 50% of events for non-critical telemetry by default. file tickets if you need 100%.

aria_a11y: one more a11y note — if we animate the drawer, respect `prefers-reduced-motion` and ensure focus is trapped when drawer open.

elaine: noted. final asks before i iterate figma: 1) confirm contrast & aria changes 2) agree on 3 tiles default + drawer 3) decide Variant A vs B for first-run 4) telemetry default is off and sampled if enabled.

sam_p: confirm all. Variant A for first-run. 3 tiles + drawer. telemetry off by default.

maria_ud: confirm. add small cost badge.

tyler_eng: I'll add aria attributes, keyboard handling, and telemetry event hook. will post a quick prototype link here when up.

elaine: awesome — thanks everyone. will update mock and ping a design review thread w/ prototype. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: reminder — quickstart prototype slot booked for staging demo on Mon 09:00 PST.

tyler_eng: noted, will aim to have interactive build by Sunday.

elaine: perfect. closing loop here — i'll upload v2 Figma by EOD.
